llm.guidance: This is an instruction-only skill (documentation/examples) that describes how to import CSVs, run analysis, and generate reports — but it contains no implementation or install instructions. Before relying on it: (1) verify where the actual analysis tool or runtime lives (the SKILL.md implies an 'openclaw' CLI plugin named ab-test-analyzer that is not included); (2) do not upload or point to sensitive data until you confirm a trusted implementation will run locally or on a trusted server; (3) note the minor metadata mismatch (version numbers) and unknown source/homepage — prefer skills with a verifiable origin; (4) if you expect this to run automatically, confirm an actual executable/package or a trusted provider implements the described functionality.
